title: VIP manual-entry tickets do not include the 09-30 rule that players created in the VIP flow default to VIP, or that converting an existing player is allowed

jira.summary: Sign-Up: VIP manual entry flow, field set, status, and Deal relation (VIP)
jira.quote: All standard sign-up fields should be available, same as regular (non-VIP) intake, plus the VIP flag (see separate VIP flag/indicator ticket).

jira.summary: Player & Sign-Up: VIP flag + visual indicator (VIP)
jira.quote: Player: confirm the existing VIP toggle/field on the Player record (Joyce referenced one already existing) and add a visual indicator — a small crown or star icon next to the Player's name — in list views and on the record itself.

what_differs: On 09-30 the client confirmed that any player created in the VIP flow defaults to VIP, and that ops may convert an existing player to VIP in edge cases. Kobi said 'we'll put that in'. WAGR-432 and WAGR-433 (both Open, no comments) do not state the default or the conversion path.
suggested_action: Add an acceptance criterion to WAGR-432 or WAGR-433: the Player VIP flag is set to true by default when the VIP flow creates the player, and ops can set VIP on an existing player.
